name: The Offering of Blood

angles.text: As a warlock, you know dark rites and bargains with souls. Even a seasoned practitioner of the fel may feel a chill at offering blood to an ancient, unknown stone.
As a priest, you may find the use of a tortured soul in an ominous blood rite troubling, whatever its fate.

faq.answer: The rite takes place at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril, within Silverpine Forest. Peril and shadowed magic haunt the area.
faq.q: Where does this ritual take place?

faq.answer: The Offering Stone is an ancient monument in Beren's Peril. It calls for blood from a willing sacrifice to unlock or drain the power within.
A Tortured Soul is given at the Offering Stone to answer the scrap of note's call for a willing sacrifice.
faq.q: What is the Tortured Soul used for?

faq.answer: The rite drains the power that animates the Offering Stone. The rough stone cracks and crumbles, leaving something glittering among its remains.
faq.q: What happens when the offering is completed?

faq.answer: No one knows who made the Offering Stone or why. The rite drains its power and destroys it, but its maker's purpose remains unknown.
faq.q: Who created the stone and why?

aliases: why is it called berens peril
faq.answer: Beren's Peril is a rocky landmark in Silverpine Forest, where wild beasts and hidden dangers lurk. Dark rites and restless souls have also left their mark there.

sections.body: Deep in Beren's Peril, the Offering Stone waits for a final offering. Scraps of note call for a willing sacrifice, and lead you to bring blood to the altar. As you approach with the restless essence, dread closes in.
sections.title: The Final Rite

sections.body: The Tortured Soul draws the stone's lingering power away. The rite drains the ancient monument instead of waking a greater terror. Its rough surface cracks, then collapses into rubble. Something glittering lies among the shattered fragments.
sections.title: Cracking the Stone

summary: At Beren's Peril, the scrap of note calls for blood at the Offering Stone. You bring a Tortured Soul to answer it.
